name: agentic-software-steward
description: A neutral Project Steward suite with an intention-first Agentic Software Harness for skill-directed fresh-context agents, executive operating loops, safe automation, graph engineering, assurance, creative delivery, and release.

interface.shortDescription: Route each craft fairly, then execute software through a disciplined agent harness.
interface.longDescription: Project Steward selects the right stage and primary craft without letting engineering suppress creative work or creative freedom damage technical truth. Its Agentic Software Steward lane provides a five-layer execution harness: situation-aware capability selection, bounded fresh-context agent dispatch, typed assembly, independent assurance, safe automation discovery, graph engineering, charter-governed executive loops, memory, and release discipline without pretending the skill suite is already a durable software-factory runtime.
